card.name: Hyphenated Arabic names, mid-name
card.fires_on: The letter piece right after the hyphen in transliterated Arabic names and surah titles, such as Zahir-ud-Din, Surat an-Nur and Ar-Rahman. It also fires weakly partway through some foreign personal names like Vicq, Zacchaeus and Jacquelyn.

modes.label: Arabic hyphen joins
modes.description: The capital or lowercase letter after the hyphen in an Arabic name or Quran chapter title.

modes.label: Foreign names
modes.description: The middle letters inside a European personal name, such as qu or ch.

card.plain: It marks the spot inside a transliterated Arabic or foreign name where the name continues after a hyphen or letter cluster.
